sealed.statement: The formation-release GCP A/B runner deploys byte-distinct fixed and single-axis-reverted sources, proves their source fingerprints differ (refusing to run a control whose reverted fingerprint equals the fixed fingerprint), writes reverted controls into a separate negative-control scenario/lane so expected control failures never contaminate the fixed consecutive-run certification population, and keeps organic fixed-source failures inside that population so they still reset the streak. Deterministic runner/probe tests prove the fixed, reverted-red, reverted-unexpected-green, and organic-fixed-failure classifications. This is a harness/tooling (process) contract in service of the parent product quest formation-release-handoff-closure-v3; it is NOT a replacement, successor, or re-scope of that quest, which remains open with done:false on its fixed-lane streak.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
